description: Fetch one customer by id: name, email, family role, lead flag, CRM status, created date. Use expand for deferred fields, e.g. field_values,credit_balance,staff_assignments. TeamUp: GET /customers/{id}.

expand.description: Comma-separated related fields to expand into full objects (dot-nested, max depth 4), e.g. customer,event.instructors.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (dot notation for nested), e.g. id,name,starts_at.

name: goteamup_get_customer
title: Get one customer
